title: How to Get the Davy Jones's Locker Trophy in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
text:
A guide explaining the location of the lowest point on the map to earn the Davy Jones's Locker trophy or achievement in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, including requirements and steps.
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced reintroduces players to the high seas and underwater exploration of the original game, enhanced for modern platforms. This updated version includes a substantial amount of content, with notable underwater experiences that become accessible around the game's halfway point.
After unlocking the diving bell in Sequence 6, players can explore deep water shipwrecks to collect treasure and complete specific objectives. One such objective is the Davy Jones's Locker trophy or achievement, which requires locating the lowest point on the map. The precise location is The Black Trench underwater shipwreck on the western side of the map. After collecting the treasure there, swimmers should approach the sunken diving bell closely to trigger the trophy or achievement.
While this is a manageable task, full completion of the game demands effort across many other objectives. The game is available now on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC, and remains an Action Adventure title from Ubisoft with a mature rating. Its core strengths lie in naval combat, stealth, and exploration, though the resync may not overhaul every aspect of the original
